Lob is a direct mail company with a mission to provide intelligent mail that is fast, personalized, and scalable.

The Role

Lob was built by technical co-founders with a vision to make the world programmable.

We offer two flagship APIs (print & mail and address verification) that enable companies to send postal mail as effortlessly as sending emails. Lob is venture-backed by some of the most reputable investors in tech, and we are building our team to shape the future of our company and meet the demands of a quickly growing customer base and dynamic product offerings.

**Senior Systems Architect**

Lob is hiring a strategic Senior Systems Architect who knows what great looks like but can adapt and build scrappy, high-impact solutions in a fast-paced environment. This role will lead the ongoing development and integration of Lob’s CPQ platform and help refine our broader technology ecosystem. You will be responsible for driving the GTM data pipelines, managing custom integrations across critical business applications, maintaining SFDC, and optimizing our tech stack for scalability and efficiency. You’ll work closely with stakeholders across the business, including Revenue Operations, Finance, Product, and Engineering.

**As the Senior Systems Architect you’ll…**

- Lead the refinement and enhancement of the CPQ platform to meet evolving business needs.
- Be a key partner to the full quote-to-cash roadmap, including billing, invoicing, revenue recognition, and financial schedules.
- Drive custom development within SFDC, building custom objects, flows, and processes to streamline operations.
- Oversee the development of custom integrations & data pipelines, including APIs, between key systems such as Salesforce (SFDC), NetSuite, CPQ, Redshift, the Lob product platform, and third-party tools.
- Connect the strategy through partnering with system owners to build and integrate new software solutions into Lob’s existing tech stack.
- Evaluate and recommend optimization opportunities within the tech stack, advising on what tools to keep or eliminate.
- Serve as the project manager for technology-driven projects, coordinating cross-functional teams and managing timelines and deliverables.
- Collaborate with Finance, RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to ensure alignment on system enhancements and integration efforts.

**What will you bring to this role…**

- Extensive experience with building and managing CPQ platforms.
- Proven experience building custom integrations across systems such as SFDC, NetSuite, and data warehouses (Redshift).
- Solid understanding of the quote-to-cash lifecycle, including billing, invoicing, and revenue recognition.
- Proficiency in SFDC custom development (Apex, Visualforce, Lightning) and admin responsibilities.
- Experience with API development, management, and troubleshooting.
- Strong background in enterprise-level financial systems integration.
- Knowledge of best practices in project management for technology projects (Agile or PMP certifications a plus).
- Exceptional problem-solving abilities and an ability to collaborate across business units.

**Recommended skills:**

- Experience with middleware platforms (e.g., Polytomic, MuleSoft, Boomi, or Zapier) for API orchestration.
- Knowledge of financial systems and processes such as ASC 606 and revenue recognition methodologies.
- Strong understanding of data architecture, including the use of data warehouses like Redshift and ETL processes.
- Experience with business intelligence tools (Looker, Tableau) to support data integration efforts.
- Knowledge of software development lifecycles and DevOps practices.

**Compensation Information**

This position is structured to receive a base salary + Restricted Stock Units

Base salary: $140,000-$162,500

## Lob Compensation & Benefits Highlights

- Healthcare Strength—Health plans are described as comprehensive with multiple options and strong employer contributions, along with access to mental-health resources. Employer-paid life and disability insurance further reinforce perceived coverage depth.

- Parental & Family Support—Extended paid parental leave for all parents and support for fertility, adoption, and broader family-planning needs are highlighted. Feedback suggests the breadth and inclusivity of these programs stand out.

- Leave & Time Off Breadth—Flexible or unlimited PTO, paid holidays, wellness days, and volunteer time off are part of the package. Feedback suggests remote-first flexibility can help employees use time off when team norms and workload permit.

## What We Do

Lob was founded in 2013 by technical co-founders with a vision to connect the world one mailbox at a time. We're transforming the way businesses use direct mail and bringing the power of technology to a traditionally manual channel. Our modern logistics and fulfillment engine helps businesses to build and scale high-quality, personalized direct mail programs without the operational burden. As we grow to meet the evolving needs of our customers and expand our product offerings, we're building a team to shape the future of direct mail.



## Why Work With Us

We believe automation is a catalyst for business success, and we’re looking for unique people like you to bring to life our vision of increasing the connectivity between the offline and online worlds. We are proud to be a carbon neutral business!
